title: Steps
description: Shows the stages of a workflow and lets the user move between them.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Earlier steps are marked complete and the current one has aria-current="step". onChange only reports navigation: validation stays in your code. Disable steps that cannot be reached yet.

read-only.title: Read-only progress
read-only.description: Without onChange the steps are a read-only progress indicator: a plain ordered list (no buttons) whose current item has aria-current="step".

StepsProps.value: Value of the current step (controlled; pair with onChange)
StepsProps.defaultValue: Value of the initial current step (uncontrolled)
StepsProps.onChange: Called with the value of the step the user navigates to. Steps only report navigation: validation and workflow transitions belong to the caller
StepsProps.readOnly: Renders the steps as a read-only progress indicator: plain list items without buttons, the current one marked aria-current="step"

StepsItem.value: Unique value of the step, matched against the Steps value
StepsItem.label: Visible label of the step
StepsItem.disabled: Prevents navigating to this step (e.g. a terminal state that is not reached yet)

cssVars.--steps-gap: Space between the steps (row and column gap)
cssVars.--steps-accent-color: Color of the current / completed indicators (defaults to --primary-color)
cssVars.--steps-current-background: Background of the current step's indicator
